pages.title: Start here
pages.text: New players should read $(l:modularmagic:tutorial)From Zero: Your First Spell$(/l).$(br2)The three categories cover tutorials, equipment and all nodes. The node index keeps similar types together and supports name searches.

pages.title: Assembly controls
pages.text: Insert a held gem with left-click; select a node with left-click; remove a leaf with right-click. Empty child slots before removing a parent. Extract roots as a whole.$(br2)Drag space or middle-drag to pan; scroll to zoom. Scroll parameters; use the ellipsis for more options.

pages.title: Hold Ctrl to look up
pages.text: Keep the Assembly Guide in your hotbar. Hover a node, core, table or wand and hold Ctrl until the lookup ring completes.$(br2)This uses Patchouli quick lookup. If its settings use Shift instead, follow that setting. The guide must be in your hotbar.

pages.title: References and expressions
pages.text: Sample icons, blocks and potion effects using reference slots: left-click with the relevant item on your cursor without consuming it; right-click to clear.$(br2)Text fields accept expressions, IDs or the requested JSON. Variables must be in scope; optional fields may be empty.
